title: The Wrong Winter
author: Cyrus Eastwick
blurb: Theo Yarrow, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
